sources.review: Whole Mt Pyre1F grave rows and complete native Crystal Soul House tombstone were reviewed together; the original single16-pixel headstone, inscription, stone edging and shadow remain intact. The separate flower-vase object below Soul House graves is not part of the stone silhouette. The two neutral floor shades use the local grave palette in this native module; a connected exterior flood excludes only those exterior floor pixels, retaining the closed stone outline and all enclosed grave highlights and inscription details.

Complete complete ship plain cabin table from actual Crystal FAST_SHIP_CABINS_NNW_NNE_NE at native1:1 pixels. Whole-object exterior mask retains every enclosed highlight and exposes the actual selected room floor; no frame, feet or seat is cropped. The complete object has the same source and donor footprint. Original foreground availability is retained; its overhead silhouette follows the complete classic object rather than painting room-floor pixels over actors. Cross-cartridge alias requires the same exact source family/MID, complete indexed-layer geometry (including transparency), and behavior; full source RGBA is separately fingerprinted. R/S general__ship is the explicit counterpart bank of Emerald general__inside_ship; all other aliases retain their exact pair name.
